name: Data-to-SQL Assistant
headline: Turn plain-English business questions into runnable SQL against your schema.
description: An instruction-SFT template for analytics and ops teams who want a small local model to translate questions like 'how many active subscribers in EU last month' into a parameterized SQL query against a known schema. Trains on (question, schema, SQL) triples so the model learns table joins, date filters, and the schema's column naming conventions. Pair with a downstream SQL validator and read-only DB role for production use.
suggested_brief: Train a NL-to-SQL model on our analytics schema (orders, users, subscriptions, events, products). Output: a single SQL statement, no commentary. Always end with a semicolon. Prefer ANSI-standard syntax; use schema-qualified table names. When the question is ambiguous, choose the most restrictive interpretation.
